errors.message: workflow aborted after extraction and store upsert: 'PIPESTATUS[2]: unbound variable' (bash 3.2 resets PIPESTATUS after the assignment that read element 0). corpus.jsonl and eligible.jsonl were never written; 60 items were stored. Fixed in workflows/collect_sources.sh by capturing PIPESTATUS into an array in one statement. This receipt was written after the fact to record the failure honestly.

extra.recovery: a new live run (next run directory) reused the stored transcripts; see SUBMISSION.md
